CT-8801, come in!|Wilco attempts to reach CT-8801|}} '''CT-8801''' was a [[clone trooper]] of the [[Galactic Republic]] who fought as part of the [[Grand Army of the Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars]]. Between [[19 BBY]] and [[18 BBY]], after the Republic [[Proclamation of the New Order|reorganized]] into the [[Galactic Empire]] at the war's end, CT-8801 continued his service in the newly formed [[Stormtrooper Corps]], functioning as a [[stormtrooper]] for the [[Imperial Army]]. At some point after the Republic's reorganization, the [[trooper]] was stationed with a [[Wilco's company|company]] of other [[Cloning|clones]] under [[Clone Captain]] [[Wilco]] on the [[Occupation of Serenno|occupied]] [[planet]] [[Serenno]]. Alongside the rest of the [[company]], CT-8801 was tasked with securing and retrieving the [[Dooku's war chest|war chest]] of [[Dooku]], the [[Death|deceased]] [[Count of Serenno]]. While patrolling near the [[Transport Three|final transport]] to be loaded, the trooper encountered the rogue [[clone commando]]s of [[Clone Force 99]], who had [[Mission to Castle Serenno|come]] to Serenno in hopes of taking some of the war chest. Incapacitated upon detecting the [[commando]]s, CT-8801's sudden neglect to report to Wilco eventually caused alarm among the Imperials and started a search for him. ==Biography== {{Quote|What? I did it quietly.''"
"''They will definitely notice when he does not report in.|Wrecker and Tech, disagreeing after stunning CT-8801|}} [[File:CT-8801patrol-SoW.png|thumb|left|300px|CT-8801 patrols the area around the departing transports.]] CT-8801 was [[Reproduction|born]] on the [[planet]] [[Kamino]] as a [[gene]]tic [[Cloning|clone]] of the [[human]] [[bounty hunter]] and [[clone template]] [[Jango Fett]] and enlisted into service for the [[Galactic Republic]] and its [[Grand Army of the Republic|army]]. While fighting in the [[Clone Wars]] against the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems]], in [[19 BBY]],''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates [[Order 66]] to the end of the [[Clone Wars]] in [[19 BBY]]. CT-8801 and the rest of the Republic's [[clone trooper]]s received orders from [[Supreme Chancellor]] [[Darth Sidious|Sheev Palpatine]] to [[Death penalty|execute]] the members of the [[Jedi Order]], who were branded state enemies, in accordance with [[Order 66]]''[[Collapse of the Republic]]'' establishes that every [[clone trooper]], which includes CT-8801, received [[Order 66]] to [[Great Jedi Purge|exterminate]] the [[Jedi Order]]. and dictated by his [[behavioral modification biochip]]. After Order 66, the war [[Mission to Mustafar|ended]], and [[Chancellor]] Palpatine [[Proclamation of the New Order|reorganized]] the Republic into the [[Galactic Empire]].''[[Ultimate Star Wars, New Edition]]'' Following the Republic's transformation, CT-8801 and the clones of the former Republic Army continued their service as [[stormtrooper]]s{{Databank|stormtroopers|Stormtroopers}} in the newly formed [[Imperial Army]]. Between 19 [['ABY-BBY' dating system|BBY]] and [[18 BBY]],{{TBBDate|201}} CT-8801 and an over forty-man-strong [[Wilco's company|company]] of clone [[trooper]]s led by [[Clone Captain]] [[Wilco]] were sent to the planet [[Serenno]], the [[homeworld]] of [[Death|deceased]] Separatist [[Head of State|leader]] [[Count of Serenno|Count]] [[Dooku]], which had been [[Occupation of Serenno|occupied]] and [[Bombardment of Serenno|ravaged]] by the Empire. Their mission was to infiltrate Dooku's former palace of [[Castle Serenno]] to retrieve his [[Dooku's war chest|war chest]], a massive stockpile of valuables that had been plundered from the worlds controlled and besieged by the Separatists during the war, and send it off-world aboard three [[class four container transport]]s. However, in the same [[Standard year|year]], as the war chest had become sought-after by the criminal underworld with Dooku's passing, a [[squad]] of rogue [[clone commando]]s known as [[Clone Force 99]] had [[Mission to Castle Serenno|traveled]] to Serenno in hopes of retrieving enough treasure to secure their freedom from both the Empire and mercenary work. [[File:CT-8801stunned-SoW.png|thumb|right|300px|CT-8801 is stunned by Wrecker.]] Arriving on the planetary surface at Castle Serenno, the squad remained undetected by the [[Imperial Military|Imperial forces]] and boarded the [[Transport Three|third transport]] before it took off. While inside the container [[transport]], CT-8801 was simultaneously conducting a patrol of the area, during which he heard clattering from inside the transport by Clone Force 99 members [[Tech]], [[Echo]], [[Wrecker]], and [[Omega]]. Alerted and attempting to investigate, Wrecker promptly [[stun]]ned and incapacitated the trooper, eventually causing alarm among the Imperials upon his failure to report back to the company of his patrol. Responding to his sudden disappearance, Captain Wilco ordered several troopers to investigate and the third transport to later depart after discovering the rogue clones. Not long after the cargo ship had taken off, CT-8801 soon woke up but was immediately stunned once more before the [[commando]]s launched themselves away aboard the containers, leaving the trooper unconscious aboard the [[freighter]]. ==Personality and traits== As a human clone of Jango Fett, CT-8801 stood at 1.83 [[meter]]s (6 [[Foot|ft]]) in height and weighed eighty [[kilogram]]s. ==Equipment== At birth, like the other clone troopers, CT-8801 was implanted by the [[Kaminoan]] [[scientist]]s with a behavioral modification biochip to ensure that the trooper would not resist certain [[Executive Order Codes for the Grand Army of the Republic|orders]]. He wore a set [[Color|white]] [[Phase II clone trooper armor]] equipped with an integrated [[comlink]]In "[[Spoils of War]]," CT-8801 was equipped with an integrated [[comlink]] on his right [[Limb|arm]] and a single [[N-20 Baradium-core thermal detonator]], identified respectively in ''[[Collapse of the Republic]]'' and ''[[Star Wars Rebels: The Visual Guide]]''. and was armed with a [[DC-15A blaster carbine]] and a single [[N-20 Baradium-core thermal detonator]] on the back of his [[utility belt]]. ==Behind the scenes== CT-8801 was introduced in "[[Spoils of War]]," the premier episode for the [[The Bad Batch Season 2|second season]] of the ''[[Star Wars: The Bad Batch]]'' animated series, which first aired on [[Disney+]] on [[January 4]], [[2023]].{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-bad-batch-season-2-trailer-key-art|text=Clone Force 99 Is Back in New ''Star Wars: The Bad Batch'' Season 2 Trailer}} Similarly to the other clone troopers in the series, CT-8801 was voiced by [[Dee Bradley Baker]]. ==Appearances== {{Mediacat|imagecat=Images of CT-8801}} *{{TBB|Spoils of War}} {{1st}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |es=CT-8801 |fr=CT-8801 |ja=CT-8801 |ka=კს-8801 |nl=CT-8801 |pl=CT-8801 }} [[Category:Clone stormtroopers]] [[Category:Clone troopers]] [[Category:Individuals of unspecified gender]] [[Category:Individuals with he/him pronouns]]
